entities.summary: William Jesse Winn Jr. is an American former professional football defensive end. He played college football for the Boise State Broncos. He was considered one of the best defensive tackle prospects for the 2012 NFL draft and was selected in the sixth round by the Cleveland Browns. He also played for the Indianapolis Colts, Denver Broncos and Green Bay Packers.
